frozen: 2026-11-02, after the initial r42 control stopped on a Tripolitania input mismatch, before any non-control candidate of this revised campaign
score: Equal-region S49 relative to r42; groups reported only; 2x penalty for each T or P regression beyond 1%.
selection: After all three 13-evaluation chains finish, choose the lowest S49 with both T and P <=+1%; require S49 <=0.995 before paired 28 km validation. No early selection, no sealed-set selection.
validation: Fresh paired 49 development regions and 28 km using scripts/validate_v3.sh with REF_NAME=r42, REF_FIT=calibration/local_accuracy_20261023/r42_params.json, SEALED_SPEC=calibration/sealed_20261102e/regions.json. Freeze finalist before any sealed result. Never adopt from training score alone.
physics: Only existing r42 Earth physics strengths, gates, wet-sun and precipitation timescale are varied within the previous frozen search bounds. Orbit, planet size, solar forcing and world geometry fixed. These are parameterized physical processes; gains do not validate each closure independently.
local_minima: One chain centred on r42, two independent scrambled Sobol centres, independent CMA seeds. All chains first reproduce r42 on all 49 regions. This probes starting-point sensitivity within this parameter box; it cannot prove global optimality or rule out missing physics.
reference_recovery: output/r42_reference_recovery_20261102/recovery.json; old campaign and every failure retained; same parameters, bounds, seeds, budget and selection, current matched reference inputs
